meta.title: Specimen Sorter API - Screen vs API
meta.subject: Manual Spec Ack actions versus the sorter POST
meta.author: LIS Team

slides.headline:
Specimen Sorter API
Screen vs the POST
slides.lede: Each Spec Ack action today is a staff click. The sorter POST must do the same work, then return Registered, Send-out, Relabel, or Failure.
slides.footer: From 01 Requirement and 02 System Design  ·  staff path unchanged
slides.notes: Walkthrough of what moves off the screen. Staff Specimen Acknowledgement stays the fallback for Relabel and Failure.

slides.title: One slide per Spec Ack action

items.title: Retrieve GCRS order
items.note: USID only, as the sorter user

slides.notes: Walk the POST in order: retrieve, send-out or register packing, then print and PHLC only if Registered.

slides.title: Staff keep the clicks. The POST owns the sorter.
slides.lede: Middleware sends a USID and sorter id. LIS returns the bin.

proofs.title: Today
proofs.body: Staff scan, see alerts, then press Send-out or Register. Packing runs on the screen.

proofs.title: The POST
proofs.body: One call. Same retrieve, send-out, register, print, and PHLC writes. Soft text is not on the body.

proofs.title: Fallback
proofs.body: Relabel and Failure go back to staff Spec Ack. No new screen.

slides.goal: Confirm each action matches Spec Ack, except mixed send-out and the Relabel checkbox.
slides.notes: Do not reuse the staff register endpoint. The sorter never calls the retrieve GET that hard-codes a demo user.

slides.title: Sorter lookup is USID only

left.label: Manual
left.title: Scan or type, then retrieve
points: Staff enter specimen no., lab no., or order no.
Format, allowed hospital, and check digit run first.
Not found stops the screen (1336 / 1337 / 1338 / 1377).

right.label: Sorter POST
right.title: USID, as the mapped user
points: Body needs usid and sorterId. No order-no lookup.
Same format rules. Miss is Failure. Wrong HKID or name is Failure.
In-process retrieve as the sorter user. APS / BBS / MBS is Failure.

callout.text: Hospital omitted on the POST comes from the sorter map and workbench.

slides.notes: The staff retrieve GET stays. The sorter must not call it. CPS and HMS only. DFT and STAR on those labs still retrieve.

slides.title: The send-out list decides, not a click

left.label: Manual
left.title: Staff press Send-out
points: Staff choose Send-out after the order is on screen.
Backend acks Printed or Collected, writes tracking, writes SEND_OUT.
A test is send-out when its cluster code is on the list for that lab and hospital.

right.label: Sorter POST
right.title: Same list. No flag from the sorter.
points: Join the test to the send-out list for lab and hospital.
All on the list: existing send-out write, status SEND_OUT.
Local plus send-out on one USID: Failure. No worksheet. No PHLC.

callout.text: The sorter does not send a send-out flag.

slides.notes: Call the list the send-out test table if asked. Mixed is Failure so the sorter does not split one tube.

slides.headline: Three jobs sit in front of Register
slides.body: Checks. Test groups and request no. Ward and doctor mapping.
slides.notes: Register already expects a packed request. That is why middleware cannot call the staff register endpoint as-is.

slides.title: Soft logs. Hard fails.

left.label: Manual
left.title: Popups on the screen
points: Soft alerts after retrieve. Staff can continue.
Hard checks before Register: mapping, datetime, test, specimen state.
Mixed local and send-out is a soft alert today.

right.label: Sorter POST
right.title: No dialogue
points: Soft: ALS only. Not on the body. Not Relabel.
Hard: HTTP 200 and FAILURE, code on the audit remark.
Mixed is Failure. No Relabel checkbox. STAR with no location is 4422.

callout.text: Ack time is server now. Missing collection date is soft. Do not invent a date.

slides.notes: Say the mixed change out loud. Staff can still click through that popup. The sorter cannot split the tube.

slides.title: Soft alerts - logged, then continue

cards.title: Missing collection date
cards.body: Proceed. Do not invent a date.

cards.title: Overnight specimen
cards.body: Same overnight window as Spec Ack. ALS only.

cards.title: Valid period / sex-age
cards.body: Test validity and valid-period warnings. ALS only.

slides.notes: First half of the soft set from the confirmed requirement. Next slide has the rest.

slides.title: Soft alerts - the rest of the set

cards.title: Duplicate / A-A-R
cards.body: Duplicate-reason and A-A-R-not-ready. ALS only. AAR stays off.

cards.title: Patient tag / private
cards.body: Private patient and patient-tag alerts. ALS only.

cards.title: STAR unbox alert
cards.body: Boxed warning is ALS. No workbench location is Failure 4422, not this card.

callout.text: BBS blood / category / T&S alerts stay on staff Spec Ack. BBS is out of v1.

slides.notes: Mixed is not here. The locked design made mixed a hard Failure.

slides.title: Hard checks that return Failure

cards.title: Unmapped ward / doctor
cards.body: Doctor, location, specialty, report dest, or report copy has no LIS id.

cards.title: Datetime
cards.body: Collection before DOB. Ack before collection or request. Ack in the future.

cards.title: STAR / mixed / empty
cards.body: No workbench location. Local plus send-out. Already used, all registered, all deleted, rejected.

callout.text: Also Failure: missing test dictionary, HKID or name mismatch, APS / BBS / MBS, unknown sorter id.

slides.notes: Do not auto-create an unmapped doctor or location. Soft set on the previous two slides is not Failure.

slides.title: USID is the request no. only when eligible

left.label: Manual
left.title: Screen groups, then assigns
points: Tests are grouped before Register. Each group needs a request no.
USID can be the request no. when the screen says it is eligible.
Staff can tick Relabel. Multi-group, multi-specimen, suffix not 0, or force: no USID.

right.label: Sorter POST
right.title: Same grouping. No checkbox.
points: Same Relabel rules, without a user tick.
One group, one specimen, suffix 0, not force: request no. = USID.
Else Relabel. No lab request. No invented number. No caller-assigned request no.

callout.text: Relabel is its own status. Not Failure. Not Registered.

slides.notes: Partial DFT remainder is Relabel. DFT still uses Spec Ack register, not the DFT register API.

slides.title: A missing map stops the POST

left.label: Manual
left.title: Map, then popup
points: Doctor, location, specialty, report dest, and report copy come from dictionary.
Unmapped codes block Register.
Staff can create a doctor when dictionary allows it.

right.label: Sorter POST
right.title: Same map. No create.
points: Same five mappings go onto the packed register call.
Any miss is Failure, same message codes as Spec Ack.
Do not auto-create a doctor or location. Send the tube to staff.

callout.text: Do not compare workbench lab to the order test lab.

slides.notes: Report destination can follow request location when that Spec Ack option is on. Port the existing rule. Do not invent a new one.

slides.title: Print all after Registered, not before

left.label: Manual
left.title: Staff print after Register
points: Staff can print GCRS, send-out, and SH worksheets after register.
If more than one worksheet, staff pick.
Labels can also print on the staff path.

right.label: Sorter POST
right.title: Print all, after the HTTP return
points: Return REGISTERED first. Then print every worksheet Spec Ack would. No picker.
Send-out, Relabel, and Failure print nothing. No labels.
Late worksheet is allowed. Print fail is ALS. Status stays Registered.

callout.text: p95 under 4 seconds is retrieve plus send-out or register. Print is off that clock.

slides.notes: Same three staff print services, in-process, no HTTP loopback. Registration only.

slides.title: PHLC after Registered, after return

left.label: Manual
left.title: Screen calls PHLC after register
points: Spec Ack creates a PHLC order when the lab option is on.
Destination must match the existing PHLC rule.
Staff wait on the screen for that call.

right.label: Sorter POST
right.title: Same create. Sorter does not wait.
points: Same PHLC create, in-process, after REGISTERED is already back.
Only when Spec Ack would send. Send-out, Relabel, and Failure skip it.
PHLC fail is ALS. Sorter status stays Registered.

callout.text: No labels on the sorter path. Worksheet and PHLC never run on Send-out.

slides.notes: PHLC is already backend. The change is when it runs. Do not invent a new PHLC contract.

slides.headline: One POST. Four bins.
slides.note: Retrieve plus send-out or register. Print and PHLC after the status is already back.

nextSteps.title: Keep the staff path
nextSteps.body: Spec Ack retrieve, Send-out, and Register stay. Relabel and Failure go there.

nextSteps.title: Move the three register jobs
nextSteps.body: Checks, grouping and request no., ward and doctor. Then the existing register write.

nextSteps.title: Print only when Registered
nextSteps.body: All worksheets, then PHLC, after HTTP return. No labels.

slides.notes: Close on the latency split so print arguments do not reopen the 4 second budget.
